_caps: A grant never exceeds its table's cap (no day cap since 2026-09-23 — 体力 alone limits a day).
_drop_tables: 刷副本 (2026-10-15): what a beast won in a rerun leaves (rules/rerun.mjs), by the table its instance names (chapter.json sealed.rerun.drops). Each roll in `rolls` lands with its `chance` (an elite's `elite_chance` when it has one) and gives one thing: an `item` by weight (`n` its count, [lo, hi]), or an arm (`gear`): a rarity drawn by `rarity` (an elite by `elite_rarity`), then one of `gear`'s arms of that rarity (items.json `rarity`). Drawn from the run's seed, the room and the beast's place in it: the same run drops the same. Only 卷一 things.
_gongke_zero: The day's 功课 handed in at 练气零层 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: every hand-in visibly raises 修为 or 灵石): 零层 takes no 修为 (state.mjs addProgress), so it pays this table instead — a few 灵石, what a 外门 杂役 errand pays (修屋顶 5). From 一层 on, `gongke`.
_tale: 今日传闻 (design.md § 今日传闻): Ling writes no number. Each step pays the `tale` table and the finale the `tale_end` table, both capped; the whole tale never pays more than `cap` (a fifth step eats into the finale), and pay() scales it by the roots and the realm like any grant. One finale `drop`: the highest-tier entry at or below the player's realm (an item, or a card not held and of a root the player has), picked by the tale's id — and the finale also leaves a 符 and raises the 本命法宝 one 重 (`growth`). Raised 2026-09-24 (redesign-v2: the rumor is the day's main dish, the daily boards are gone): 15 a step, 30 the finale, 90 the cap — see `_economy`.
_stamina: stamina is the pace — design.md § 灵气. Refills by the clock, full in refill_hours; actions cost it; a quest paid refills it (the app's own `qi`, else refill.quest). `shouchao`: a night of 兽潮 (2026-10-20) costs a fight's, taken as the night is counted.
_her_card: 银月's card grows both ways (Hanli, 2026-09-24: 两个都做). `realm`: with the player's realm, as the player's 气血/灵力 grow — the lift at the highest realm listed at or below theirs (the fight's own realm table, battle.js REALMS, ends at 元婴, so hers does too). `gifts`: the story gives her an ability at the 3rd, 6th and 9th cauldron found, each costing one of her reflections (companion.json secret); `lift` is what it adds to her card in a fight. No relationship score (redesign-v2 § 四). Numbers weighed by the gate (tools/battle-sim.mjs § 银月).

_seclusion: 闭关修炼 (his, 2026-09-24: one pick per seclusion; rules/seclusion.mjs). Real hours from the save's own stamp, at most `cap_hours`; under `min_hours` nothing but the clock's refill. One focus: a 功法 gains a ★ per `star_hours` (to `star_top`; the hours left over wait for the next seclusion on that card), 修为 an hour's share of the layer he sits on (balance.json play_pay.seclusion: a `rest_hours` night is 10% of the layer since 2026-10-27, 数值系统 phase 2 — 闭关 is the idle fallback, play is the game), or the 本命法宝 one 重 per `treasure_hours` (left over kept). Any focus: `rest_hours` or more fills 体力. A pill in `pills` taken going in multiplies the hours counted (not the cap on real hours).

_growth: 本命法宝 and 符 grow from the story, never from a daily tap (redesign-v2 § 四: 温养 · 强化 · 写符 cut). The treasure rises one 重 each time a chapter ends and each time 今日传闻's finale is won, up to 九重. A rumor's finale leaves one 符; a fight won leaves one on one win in `fight_one_in` (by the day, the beast and the 名字).
_pouch: 储物袋 (Hanli, 2026-09-25): the bag's room, counted in slots — one item id is one slot, stacks unlimited; a key, a thing the open chapter or a taken errand still needs, and her bell take none. `by_tier` is the room at each realm (the highest row at or below his); a bigger pouch bought at a 坊市 (items.json `effect.pouch`) adds its slots for good, once each. Full: a drop, a reward or a grant waits at the 洞府 (待取) until he taps it in; a find on the road and a purchase are refused. A 练气 player in 徐 holds 8–12 kinds; 24 is room to spare until the later provinces' materials pile up.
